findings.evidence: 2/2 landing-candidate pages affected (100.0%). Fewer than three internal links each.
findings.mechanism: A visitor arriving mid-funnel has not seen the home page and has no mental model of the site. A page with no onward links answers one question and then ends the session, forfeiting every subsequent step.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Deep arrivals continue into a second and third page instead of leaving.
steps: Link to the two or three most relevant related pages from within the body copy.
Add a related-content block at the end of each page.
Ensure primary navigation is reachable from every page.
suggested_action.summary: Add contextual onward links and a clear next step to every content page.
suggested_action.verification: All landing pages carry three or more internal links.

findings.title: Landing pages offer almost no onward links
